methodology.selection: At most 40 previously unseen works per split and format; seven source-diversity ranked and three seeded controls; one region per work within each format stratum. Excludes all work groups in original 116 source-color fixtures. 129 candidates represent 126 unique work groups; no development/holdout work overlap.
methodology.oracle: Assistant source-image visual review before predictions; background swatches or representative spatial colors for gradients. Silver OCR boxes. Not human gold.
methodology.metric: Maximum absolute sRGB channel error <=25; absent observed background is failure
methodology.split: Existing work-disjoint development/holdout partition. Two holdout annotation errors were corrected after first predictions; final suite is a reviewed regression set, not untouched holdout. Algorithm was frozen after development and did not change during holdout audit.
